defect: Replacing UIShader_Prepare() by only RebindTexture plus a blend state dropped the resets of depth test, stencil test, culling and scissor, so in non-buffered rendering the game's leftover GL state applies to the overlay and the on-screen buttons can disappear.
reason: The fix draws the overlay through UIContext::Begin, which disables depth/stencil and culling as UIShader_Prepare did; the resets were lost in this change, and seeing that needs UIShader.cpp.

defect: The new globals (waitingThreads, isNeedInput, numNeedSamples, audioBufSize) are never reset by __UsbMicInit/__UsbMicShutdown, so after exiting to the menu and starting again stale waiting threads and flags survive (and audioBuf is freed while audioBufSize keeps its value).
reason: The fix initializes this state in __UsbMicInit; the state and the incomplete init/shutdown were added by this change.

defect: The added __IoCompleteAsyncIO(f) calls in __IoSyncNotify consume the ioManager result (and fire the async callback), so the following ioManager.WaitResult fails and the threaded synchronous read/write returns -1.
reason: The fix removes exactly these two added calls; seeing the conflict needs the body of __IoCompleteAsyncIO, outside the hunks.

defect: Rewriting '#if defined(_M_ARM64) || defined(_M_ARM)' as '#if PPSSPP_API(ANY_GL)' lost the negation, so the GE debugger menu item is grayed out on every GL build.
reason: The fix adds the missing '!' to the line this change wrote.

defect: For 16-bit formats CheckAlpha walks a u32 pointer but advances it by stride (in pixels) per row, twice the row size, so it skips rows and reads past the buffer.
reason: The fix advances by stride/2; the per-row stride loop was added in this change.

defect: update() calls MIPSComp::jit->ClearCache() when the debug-stats toggle changes, guarded only by a non-null jit pointer, which stays set after a game shuts down, so toggling it from the menu after exiting a game crashes.
reason: The fix routes it to a 'clear jit' handler that also requires PSP_IsInited(); seeing it needs the jit lifetime in MIPS.cpp.

defect: The vendor match was changed from 'Apple' to 'Apple Inc.' instead of adding the new string, so drivers that report 'Apple' are no longer detected as GPU_VENDOR_APPLE.
reason: The fix accepts both strings; the dropped match is in the changed line.

defect: With host IO timing, __IoAsyncNotify reschedules itself until ioManager.HasResult, but async operations that never queue on the IO thread never produce a result, so their notification loops forever and the game hangs.
reason: The fix adds '&& ioManager.HasOperation'; seeing it needs the async callers that complete without queueing.

defect: The new common BlitFramebuffer passes unscaled coordinates (factor 1.0) on the non-blit path, but the new BlitUsingRaster normalizes by the render-scaled FBO size, so at render scale above 1 the wrong region is blitted.
reason: The fix always applies renderScaleFactor; the GL original normalized by bufferWidth, and this change's raster helper uses the scaled FBO dimensions.

defect: DeleteData tests 'param->fileName == NULL' on a char array, which is never true, so an empty file name is not rejected and the deletion targets the save directory path.
reason: The fix tests fileName[0]; the bogus check was added in this change.

defect: The SSE4.1 branch of Jit_ApplyFog calls GetGState() again into a shadowing local, locking the gstate register twice but unlocking it once.
reason: The fix deletes the duplicate call that this change added.

defect: A std::string (discID) is passed for %s to the variadic StringFromFormat, which is undefined behaviour and does not compile on GCC/Clang.
reason: The fix passes discID.c_str().

defect: The new GameAchievementSummaryView::Draw passes 0.0 as the opacity, so the summary is drawn with a fully transparent background (and, once alpha was applied to text, invisible text).
reason: The fix passes 1.0 for this new call and for the older AchievementView call that this change copied.

defect: ExecuteOp now dereferences currentList->pc (default-case log, ORIGIN, jumps) where it used the always-valid dcontext, but ReapplyGfxState calls ExecuteOp outside any list while currentList is NULL, crashing.
reason: The fix guards the null currentList in the default case; the caller is in GPUState.cpp.

defect: 'using namespace KeyMap' lacks its semicolon, so KeyMap.cpp does not compile.
reason: The fix adds the semicolon to the line this change added.

defect: The condition 'fmt == GPU_DBG_FORMAT_8888 || GPU_DBG_FORMAT_8888_BGRA || ...' has a constant non-zero operand, so every format gets pixelSize 4.
reason: The fix adds the missing 'fmt ==' in the line this change wrote.

defect: The new Symbian branch tests 'defined(SYMBIAN)' instead of '__SYMBIAN32__', so it never compiles in and the Symbian CPU info is not set.
reason: The fix corrects the macro; the surrounding #if in the diff already uses __SYMBIAN32__.

defect: The new DXT5 decoder fills the interpolated alpha table in reverse order (alpha[2] = lerp8(src, 6) instead of lerp8(src, 1), etc.), so interpolated alpha values are wrong.
reason: The fix reverses the lerp arguments in the table added by this change.

defect: The new Symbian ReleaseView decommits at view - Base() without masking by 0x3FFFFFFF, while the views were committed at masked offsets, so Return to Menu decommits wrong ranges and crashes.
reason: The fix masks the offset in the line this change added; the masked Commit is visible in the same diff.

defect: __AdjustBGMVolume is given numSamples * pFrame->channels (input channels) although swr_convert writes atracOutputChannels channels, so mono sources are only half scaled and stereo-to-mono output is overrun.
reason: The fix uses atracOutputChannels in both lines added by this change.

defect: The fix corrects the pre-existing ClipToScreen scaling (division by 4095.9375/4096.9375 times 0xFFFF) and then drops this change's w/50 boundary-nudging workaround as no longer needed.
reason: The repaired transformation lines are unchanged context in this change; removing the workaround is cleanup after the root fix.

defect: Refresh calls rows_.empty() instead of rows_.clear(), so rows_ keeps pointers to rows deleted by Clear() and later SetFocus on rows_[i] touches freed views.
reason: The fix replaces empty() with clear() in the line this change added.

defect: The added else branch frees a buffer from new[] with free(), a mismatched deallocation.
reason: The fix uses delete[] in the line this change added.

defect: The labels of the PSP Start and Select buttons are run through the Dialog translations, sharing the 'Select' key used for the Cross action, so translated builds show wrong button names.
reason: The fix restores the untranslated Start/Select labels (and shifts the Delete label) in lines this change edited.

defect: The new Windows branch has a syntax error (',' followed by 'const DWORD'), uses '_handle' for 'handle_', and lacks the utf8 include for ConvertUTF8ToWString, so the Windows build fails.
reason: The fix corrects these three errors in code this change added.

defect: I18NCategory now keeps name_ as a raw const char* without copying, but LoadIni creates categories with section names owned by a local IniFile, leaving dangling name pointers.
reason: The fix restores std::string name_; the dangling source is in i18n.cpp.

defect: This commit's Achievements::ChangeUMD sets g_isIdentifying = true after rc_client_begin_change_media, so when the callback runs synchronously the flag stays true and IsBlockingExecution stalls emulation after a UMD swap.
reason: The fix sets the flag before starting the request (and supplies a block device); the ordering bug is in RetroAchievements.cpp code added by this commit, not in the sceUmd.cpp hunk.

defect: The new LoadAtlasMetadata skips loading once metadata is loaded, so switching to a theme with another UIAtlas keeps the old metadata while the new .zim image is bound.
reason: The fix drops the IsMetadataLoaded guard that this change added.

defect: ChallengeModeActive now returns rc_client_get_hardcore_enabled and the explicit hardcore disable at init was removed; rc_client defaults to hardcore, so while logged out challenge mode reports active and savestates are hidden.
reason: The fix requires IsLoggedIn(); seeing it needs rc_client's hardcore default.

defect: The Symbian executable allocator now Alloc()s the whole chunk size from a heap whose maximum equals it (the macro's trailing ';' discards '+ 3*GetPageSize()'), bumps a void* and never resets, so the allocation fails or overruns and the JIT crashes.
reason: The fix removes the ';', switches to a u8* bump pointer with AllocZ and adds a reset; the bump allocator was added in this change.

defect: In the new state machine the 'already populated from cache' early return of PrepareData never sets ACTIVE, so cached textures stay non-ACTIVE, CopyLevelTo refuses them and the post-wait assert fires.
reason: The fix sets ACTIVE on that path and widens the assert added by this change.

defect: 'MIPSGPReg rd = _RD:' ends with a colon instead of a semicolon, breaking the ARM build.
reason: The fix corrects the character in the line this change added.

defect: Download starts a detached thread bound to a raw 'this', while Downloader::Update erases the only shared_ptr once Failed/Progress is set, so the thread can run on a destroyed Download.
reason: The fix passes a shared_ptr to the thread to keep the object alive; the lifetime design was added in this change.

defect: The new GuessDrawingSize heuristic (minimum of viewport, scissor and region) together with commenting out the v->width/height update gives some framebuffers the wrong size, losing Growlanser's title screens.
reason: The fix restores the commented-out update and reworks the heuristic this change introduced; the regression is game-specific and not visible from code.

defect: The 0x200000 depth-swizzle hack is applied to any depth texture with those address bits, not only to 8888 framebuffers, which breaks Katamari.
reason: The fix adds the format condition to the hack added in this change; needing it depends on PSP hardware behaviour.

defect: The new view and projection fast-load loops break on '++i > end', loading one entry too many: past the end of the matrix and consuming an extra command.
reason: The fix changes the bound to '>='; the view/proj loops were added here (copying the same off-by-one from the tgen/bone loops).

defect: num = iFrameSkip - 1 is 0 when frameskip is 1, and gpuStats.numFrames % num divides by zero.
reason: The fix no longer subtracts 1 from iFrameSkip in the line this change wrote.

defect: Moving GL context creation to a render thread left SwapInterval calling wglSwapIntervalEXT on the calling emu/UI thread, where no context is current, so VSync changes have no effect.
reason: The fix delegates the swap interval to the render manager's thread; seeing it needs the callers of SwapInterval.

defect: The moved SubmitPrimitive loop increments vtx by 1 instead of 3 while reading vertices vtx..vtx+2, drawing a triangle per vertex and reading past the decoded vertices.
reason: The original SoftGpu.cpp loop used vtx += 3 and the fix restores it; the stride mismatch is visible in the added loop.

defect: The generated GLSL assigns the vec4 uniform u_matambientalpha to a lowp vec3, which fails shader compilation.
reason: The fix wraps it in vec3(); the diff context shows u_matambientalpha used as a vec4.
